name: Escape Online Internet
summary: Separate Melbourne-based national ISP (born 1996, Escape Communications Pty Ltd; escapenet.com.au -> escapeonline.com.au). Still operating. NOT the same as WA's Escape Net or Adelaide's EscapeNet — distinct entity.
